observations.title: Public ETH materials collection
observations.factual_summary: The public listing shows separate Anthropic and OpenAI folders, ReadMe, the community letter and Sahai_Amit. ReadMe describes view-only access by link and a collection of notes and corrections. A separate manual public rendering of https://drive.google.com/file/d/1u1XufQIU-PZafNWRO1Is-SUlX760agVp/view showed a 49-page Claude/Anthropic document titled A 2^{o(n)} Time Algorithm for 3-SAT, dated October 26. A separate manual public rendering of https://drive.google.com/file/d/1p3L0yuyx2lkY5DurwokzOgpYWPYRy1N2/view showed a 17-page OpenAI document titled Exactly Counting 3-SAT Solutions in Subexponential Time, dated October 17.
attribution_caveats: The child facts came from separate manual public renderings; no automated crawler or recursive child verification is claimed.
The Anthropic document is a separate claim and does not validate the OpenAI claim. The OpenAI child is dated October 17 and is not the October 25 manuscript.
Document titles, dates and displayed attribution do not establish proof correctness or authenticated real-world authorship.
The exact per-source observation time is unknown within the shared observation window.
